column3: With respect to the 1010 Pacific Street Mortgage Loan (4.2%), the Phase I ESA identifies as a CREC for the Mortgaged Property impacts to soil caused by a long history of onsite manufacturing operations and by other operations that included the use of at least one underground storage tank. Subsurface investigations were conducted at the Mortgaged Property from 2015 to 2020 pursuant to a Voluntary Cleanup Program (“VCP”) agreement entered into with the New York City Office of Environmental Remediation (“NYCOER”). As a result of the investigative findings, various excavation activities were performed, and the Mortgaged Property received a Notice of Completion from the NYCOER under the VCP.
